en: The front of the postcard features a historical city square lined with grand buildings and a prominent public fountain topped with a statue. There are trees and benches in the square, as well as a few people walking around. In the bottom left, there is a small inset portrait photograph of a man, labeled 'Rudolf Pettersson, Höganäs.' Text at the top right reads 'Sundsvall 11.5.1902.' The reverse side is addressed to Fröken Maria Mattsson in Fridhems, Sköglösa, and features a Swedish postage stamp and traditional decorative postcard border.
